drawContract: Battle.randomizer invokes Battle.random(16) exactly once; the caller supplies the resulting roll.

controlledGrid.purpose: Controlled arithmetic oracle: Battle.random alone is replaced temporarily to provide each roll; Battle.randomizer and truncation are the pinned implementations.

liveSeeded.drawContract: wrapper only logs and returns the original seeded Battle.random result after Battle initialization; these are not asserted to be the seed PRNG first draws
